summary.zh: 一般过去时（Simple Past Tense）用于描述过去某一明确时间发生并已经结束的动作、状态或事件。它常与 yesterday, last week, in 2019, two years ago, when I was a child 等过去时间状语连用。在 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 写作、口语中，一般过去时常用于描述个人经历、历史事实、实验过程、数据变化以及过去的研究结果。中国学习者需要特别注意动词过去式形式、助动词 did 后使用动词原形、以及过去时间语境中不要误用现在完成时。

structure.formula: 肯定句：Subject + past verb / was / were + Object / Complement. 否定句：Subject + did not + base verb + Object. Be 动词否定句：Subject + was / were not + Complement. 一般疑问句：Did + subject + base verb + Object? Be 动词疑问句：Was / Were + subject + Complement?
structure.explanation: 一般过去时的核心是“动作或状态发生在过去，并且已经结束”。普通实义动词在肯定句中使用过去式，例如 worked, studied, developed；不规则动词需要单独记忆，例如 went, made, found, became。否定句和疑问句中使用助动词 did，此时主要动词必须还原为原形，例如 did not go，而不是 did not went。若谓语是 be 动词，则根据主语使用 was 或 were，不再使用 did。

examples.en: The researcher collected data from 200 participants last year.
examples.zh: 这位研究人员去年从200名参与者那里收集了数据。

examples.en: The results were significant in the first experiment.
examples.zh: 第一次实验中的结果具有显著性。

examples.en: She did not attend the lecture yesterday.
Did the government introduce the policy in 2020?
examples.zh: 政府是在2020年推出这项政策的吗？

usage_scenarios.title: 描述过去某一明确时间发生的动作
usage_scenarios.description: 当句子中出现明确的过去时间，如 yesterday, last month, in 2018, three days ago 时，通常使用一般过去时。该用法在 IELTS Writing Task 1 描述过去年份的数据、PTE Summarize Written Text 概括历史事件时很常见。

examples.en: The company launched its online platform in 2016.
examples.zh: 这家公司在2016年推出了其线上平台。

examples.en: The number of international students increased sharply between 2005 and 2010.
examples.zh: 2005年至2010年间，国际学生人数大幅增加。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述过去的状态或身份
usage_scenarios.description: 一般过去时不仅表示动作，也可以表示过去存在的状态、身份、位置或情况。此时常用 was 或 were，尤其适用于口语中介绍过去经历，或写作中描述过去背景。

examples.en: The city was a major industrial centre in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这座城市在19世纪是一个重要的工业中心。

examples.en: Many rural areas were underdeveloped before the new infrastructure project.
examples.zh: 在新的基础设施项目之前，许多农村地区发展不足。

usage_scenarios.title: 叙述过去连续发生的一系列事件
usage_scenarios.description: 在讲故事、描述个人经历或复述听力内容时，一般过去时可用于按时间顺序呈现多个已完成动作。PTE Retell Lecture 和 IELTS Speaking Part 2 中经常需要这种叙述能力。

examples.en: I arrived at the testing centre, checked my documents, and waited for the exam to begin.
examples.zh: 我到达考试中心，核对了证件，然后等待考试开始。

examples.en: The scientists observed the samples, recorded the findings, and published the report.
examples.zh: 科学家们观察了样本，记录了发现，并发表了报告。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述过去的习惯或重复性行为
usage_scenarios.description: 一般过去时可以表示过去经常发生、但现在未必继续的行为。若强调“过去常常”，也可使用 used to，但普通一般过去时同样正确。

examples.en: People relied heavily on printed newspapers before digital media became widespread.
examples.zh: 在数字媒体普及之前，人们高度依赖纸质报纸。

examples.en: When I was in high school, I reviewed vocabulary every morning.
examples.zh: 我上高中时，每天早上复习词汇。

usage_scenarios.title: 报告过去研究、实验或调查结果
usage_scenarios.description: 在学术英语中，如果某项研究、实验或调查已经完成，描述其方法和发现时通常使用一般过去时。这一点在 IELTS Writing Task 2 引用研究、PTE Writing 概括材料时非常重要。

examples.en: A recent survey found that remote workers reported higher job satisfaction.
examples.zh: 一项近期调查发现，远程工作者报告了更高的工作满意度。

examples.en: The experiment demonstrated that sleep deprivation reduced cognitive performance.
examples.zh: 该实验表明，睡眠不足降低了认知表现。

common_mistakes.wrong: I did not went to the library yesterday.
common_mistakes.correct: I did not go to the library yesterday.
common_mistakes.explanation: 助动词 did 已经体现过去时，后面的实义动词必须使用原形 go，不能再使用过去式 went。中国学习者常因“过去时要加过去式”的思维而重复标记时态。

common_mistakes.wrong: She go to Australia last year.
common_mistakes.correct: She went to Australia last year.
common_mistakes.explanation: last year 是明确的过去时间状语，谓语动词需要使用过去式。go 的过去式是不规则形式 went。

common_mistakes.wrong: They was satisfied with the results.
common_mistakes.correct: They were satisfied with the results.
common_mistakes.explanation: 主语 they 是复数，过去时 be 动词应使用 were，而不是 was。was 用于 I, he, she, it 或单数名词。

common_mistakes.wrong: Did he finished the assignment on time?
common_mistakes.correct: Did he finish the assignment on time?
common_mistakes.explanation: 一般疑问句中使用 Did 后，主要动词必须用原形 finish。不能写成 Did he finished。

common_mistakes.wrong: In 2019, the population has increased significantly.
common_mistakes.explanation: in 2019 表示一个已经结束的过去时间点或时间段，应使用一般过去时。现在完成时通常不与明确的过去时间连用。

common_mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I am very tired after the exam.
common_mistakes.correct: Yesterday I was very tired after the exam.
common_mistakes.explanation: yesterday 表明时间在过去，be 动词应从 am 改为 was。描述过去状态时也要使用过去时。

common_mistakes.wrong: The data was collected and analyse in 2021.
common_mistakes.correct: The data was collected and analysed in 2021.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在被动结构中，两个并列动词都应使用过去分词。英式英语中常写 analysed，美式英语为 analyzed。PTE 和 IELTS 都接受两种拼写，但同一篇文章中应保持一致。

pte_usage.description: 一般过去时在 PTE Academic 中非常常见，尤其用于复述讲座中的历史背景、实验过程、调查结果和作者过去的观点。在口语部分，如果题目要求描述个人经历、过去事件或讲座中提到的研究，考生需要稳定使用一般过去时。写作部分也常需要用一般过去时概括材料中已经发生的事实。错误使用时态会影响 Grammar 和 Content 的评分，特别是在 Summarize Written Text、Write Essay、Retell Lecture 和 Describe Image 中。

academic_patterns.pattern: The data showed a significant increase in + noun.
academic_patterns.translation: 数据显示……出现了显著增长。

academic_patterns.pattern: The policy led to + noun phrase.
The number of + plural noun + rose/fell from A to B.
This approach proved effective in + -ing form.
academic_patterns.translation: 这种方法在……方面被证明是有效的。

academic_patterns.pattern: The experiment was conducted to examine + noun phrase.
academic_patterns.translation: 该实验被开展用于研究……

ai_tips: 看到明确过去时间状语，如 yesterday, last year, in 2020, two decades ago，优先判断是否应使用一般过去时。
在 PTE 口语复述中，如果讲座内容讲的是已完成的研究或历史事件，使用 found, showed, argued, developed, changed 等过去式动词更自然。
写作中引用已完成研究时，不要机械使用 present perfect；若有明确过去时间或研究已结束，通常用一般过去时。
检查否定句和疑问句时，重点确认 did 后面的动词是否为原形，例如 did not increase, did the figure rise。
描述图表中已经结束的年份区间时，一般过去时比一般现在时更准确，例如 The figure rose between 1990 and 2000。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改为一般过去时：The government introduces a new education policy.
practice_questions.answer: The government introduced a new education policy.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：The number of applicants (increase / increased) significantly in 2018.
改正错误：Did the researchers found a clear connection?
practice_questions.answer: Did the researchers find a clear connection?

practice_questions.question: 用一般过去时翻译：这项调查显示，大多数学生更喜欢在线学习。
practice_questions.answer: The survey showed that most students preferred online learning.

practice_questions.question: 填空：The experiment _____ conducted in a controlled environment last month.
改为否定句：She attended the seminar yesterday.
practice_questions.answer: She did not attend the seminar yesterday.

practice_questions.question: 用一般过去时翻译：1990年至2000年间，城市人口迅速增长。
practice_questions.answer: The urban population grew rapidly between 1990 and 2000.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确句子：A. He did not completed the task. B. He did not complete the task.
practice_questions.answer: B. He did not complete the task.

practice_questions.question: 根据提示造句：the data / show / a steady decline / in 2021
practice_questions.answer: The data showed a steady decline in 2021.

practice_questions.question: 改正错误：They was responsible for the project last year.
practice_questions.answer: They were responsible for the project last year.
